mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 2.0% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals labor market deterioration and economic weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate broad economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both PAYEMS and INDPRO decline.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansion characterized by strong GDP growth (GDPC1 above 3.5% annualized) triggers profit-taking and rate expectations, causing S&P 500 underperformance over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth (yoy) exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% triggers hawkish monetary policy, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL (yoy) > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strengthening consumer demand and economic activity, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST rises (mo/mo).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 105.0 signals manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: Declining retail sales (RSAFS) combined with rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates weakening consumer demand and monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS declines and FEDFUNDS rises.
